files.summary: clarify actual authoring execution, approval and privacy boundaries
edits:
The finite owner-authoring executor is a **native Macrofold harness with OpenLegend registered as an MCP connector**. Ordinary actor-scoped recipe inference, supplied proposals and tool-less discussion retain their distinct existing entrypoints; they are not equivalent to this privileged session or a transparent fallback when native authoring is unavailable. Retain only current functional consumers, not a compatibility-only copy of a prior invention loop.
The accepted broader policy permits an explicit simple invention to authorize low-impact activation within its envelope; ordinary finite recipe admission already has its separate automatic path. The current owner-authoring session instead requires exact human review before every first live write, as specified below. Lower-impact automatic approval in that session remains INV-18.2 work, not current behavior. Read/draft/refine/validate operations proceed without repeated modal confirmation. Consequential shared-law migration, destructive modification, freeze changes, conjuring, elevated disclosure and expanded funding retain their corresponding approval requirements.
The delivery slices are specified in the scenario ladder and INV-16/18/21. There is no promise that simply turning on a connector makes every future kind adapter or migration available. Enable what is implemented and explicitly report the rest. [Initial write evidence](verification/workshop-continuation.md), [later local native-harness evidence](verification/world-agent-context.md#final-local-qualification) and [remaining gates](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) distinguish delivered local execution from deployable-build and broader live/scale qualification.
The write-capable implementation uses one application `WorldAuthoringService` over the existing world writer and attempts ledger. `WorldAgentStore` retains operational sessions and typed draft/review/turn records in two indexed tables. These records are not new mechanical truth and are not rewound by gameplay load. A session binds the initiating account and character, current login/grant revision, exact world/timeline, configured connector identity, controlled inventor where relevant, admitted allowance and a hashed context handle. Opening or reconnecting the same session never allocates another allowance. The MCP credential alone permits no session mutation; write tools additionally require a currently valid session handle and write opt-in. Browser and handle-bound reads recheck the account’s current inspection grant. Private-subject admission excludes other humans' evidence, but WW11 records the current post-wait inspected-actor ownership race; a valid reader grant alone cannot authorize returning evidence after that actor becomes another player's character. Unbound service-bearer reads exclude human characters and their contained objects. Cold retained memory comes from the canonical scoped memory repository, never only the hot world cache.
